title: Combined High-Dimensional and Reduced-Order Modeling Based on an Iterative Domain Decomposition Method
summary: A method is developed for structural analysis in which parts of an analysis domain are modeled by reduced-order models (ROMs) and the remaining part is modeled by a high-dimensional model (HDM). The multiple ROMs and HDM are combined based on an iterative domain decomposition method (DDM) with an arbitrary number of non-overlapping subdomains. A diagonal preconditioner is derived for the iterative DDM. The method is implemented based on a framework of the existing DDM-based analysis code. The ROM is implemented on GPU.
